scope: Six Italian Google Play descriptions from the same Easybrain, Oakever, Brainium, Andoku, Guru and GamoVation international samples. All retrieved with hl=it. Not an Italian download/popularity ranking or proof of Italy-exclusive text.
method: NFC, lowercase, whitespace collapse, curly apostrophes normalized to straight apostrophes and dash variants to hyphen. Exact contiguous phrases delimited by Unicode letters/digits. Accents retained; singular/plural, inflections and synonyms remain distinct. Body between Informazioni sul gioco and Ultimo aggiornamento, including public short description if supplied. Excludes titles, tags, reviews, screenshots, related-app cards and linked sites; literal URLs/emails within body remain part of sampled text. Nested rows can overlap. Cache/region can affect the sample. Full competitor prose is not persisted.

terminologySources.use: Easybrain's Italian rules and technique wording: griglia, caselle, riga, colonna, blocco, note. Separate terminology check, not added to app-description counts or used to infer difficulty from clue count.
Verifies naked-single meaning: one possible digit in a cell; Singoli ovvi/Singoli nudi are publisher synonyms. Does not imply an app UI rename.
Verifies hidden-single meaning: a digit has only one possible location in a unit.

Italian game publisher's indexed page supplies candidati, celle, box and numero singolo wording; direct open failed, indexed text was readable. Used for meaning only; unrelated difficulty-by-clue and cognitive claims not adopted.
